indexes.//: The check-in list: everyone who has arrived but has no bracelet yet, in name order. Firestore supports equality against null, so this is the query behind the 'Who is this?' screen.
Prefix search on the check-in list, for when the roster outgrows loading it whole. See docs/firestore-schema.md, 'Search'.
Per-terminal cash-up: what did this device take tonight. Composite, so it belongs here rather than in fieldOverrides.
Per-staff-member cash-up, for the same reason.

//: End-of-night reconciliation reads every participant's ledger at once: a collection-group query ordered by createdAt alone. That is a SINGLE-field index, and Firestore rejects single-field indexes declared in the composite list ('this index is not necessary, configure using single field index controls'). Single-field indexes already exist automatically, but only at COLLECTION scope — the COLLECTION_GROUP variant has to be requested explicitly, which is what a fieldOverride does.
